node.title: Sharp rate-half FPC5 contributors have a six-value rational-map encoding
node.statement: Every exact sharp rate-half M=4,t=2 contributor injects into a degree-(2ell-3) rational map phi=L_1A_1/(L_2A_2). Its complete reduced 1-fiber is the defect set in the core; the two touched petals lie in the zero and pole fibers; the full background lies in the c_1/c_2 fiber; and each untouched petal avoids its own distinct marked fiber. The core, background, and four petals partition the whole official domain. This is a typed descriptor, not a count.
